notes: not_member (agent-judge-pro75): decisions.md D10 (T5, fund-shaped position): Oxford Sciences Innovation (renamed Oxford Science Enterprises in 2021, excluded under the same ruling) is an investment company; the firm's own 2015 listing called it 'a fund that provides capital and business expertise to companies developed in Oxford University'. name: Seedling
notes: not_member (agent-judge-pro75): Merger consideration, not an investment (COLLECTION.md s1, the share-swap reading of the sale-consideration rule): GV's company here was Moonfrye (listed 2013 to 2014, a row of its own), renamed P.S. XO, which merged with the New Zealand toy and craft company Seedling in October 2014; the combined company kept the Seedling name, Seedling had never taken outside money, and the $7M raised with the merger came from Upfront Ventures and Greycroft, not GV (TechCrunch, 2014-10-29). The firm lists Seedling from 2015, right after its Moonfrye listing ends. Moonfrye stays the member. Flagged for Erik: the parties called it a merger of equals.

name: Oxford Science Enterprises
partners_site: Krishna Yeshwant; Tom Hulme; Vidu Shanmugarajah
notes: not_member (agent-judge-pro75): decisions.md D10 (T5, fund-shaped position): an investment company, not an operating company. The firm's own 2015 listing described Oxford Sciences Innovation (renamed Oxford Science Enterprises in 2021) as 'a fund that provides capital and business expertise to companies developed in Oxford University'; GV holds an interest in the vehicle, the LP-stake class (the Sutter Hill D6 reading).

name: Curie.Bio
notes: not_member (agent-judge-pro75): decisions.md D10 (T5, fund-shaped position): Curie.Bio is a biotech venture firm, not an operating company.
